description: This Scala source file defines the SparkConnectSessionManager class, which manages Spark Connect sessions, including creation, retrieval, cloning, expiration, and shutdown of sessions within the Spark environment.

classes.name: SparkConnectSessionManager
classes.description: Manages Spark Connect sessions, including creation, retrieval, cloning, expiration, and shutdown, with thread-safe handling and periodic maintenance.

methods.name: initializeBaseSession
methods.description: Initializes the base SparkSession from the provided SparkContext.

methods.name: getOrCreateIsolatedSession
methods.description: Finds or creates a new isolated SparkSession based on userId and sessionId.

methods.name: getIsolatedSession
methods.description: Retrieves an existing SparkSession or throws an error if not found or closed.

methods.name: getIsolatedSessionIfPresent
methods.description: Returns an existing SparkSession if present, otherwise None.

methods.name: cloneSession
methods.description: Clones an existing session with a new session ID, sharing configuration and catalog state.

methods.name: validateCloneTargetSession
methods.description: Validates the target session ID for cloning, ensuring proper format and availability.

methods.name: getSession
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a session in the session store, updating access time.

methods.name: removeSessionHolder
methods.description: Removes a session from the store and optionally adds it to the closed cache.

methods.name: shutdownSessionHolder
methods.description: Shuts down a session and updates the closed cache.

methods.name: closeSession
methods.description: Closes a session identified by session key.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the session manager, stopping maintenance executor and clearing caches.

methods.name: listActiveSessions
methods.description: Returns a list of all active session info objects.

methods.name: listClosedSessions
methods.description: Returns a list of all closed session info objects.

methods.name: schedulePeriodicChecks
methods.description: Schedules periodic cleanup of expired sessions.

methods.name: periodicMaintenance
methods.description: Performs cleanup of expired sessions based on timeout settings.

methods.name: newIsolatedSession
methods.description: Creates a new isolated SparkSession based on the base session.

methods.name: validateSessionCreate
methods.description: Validates session creation parameters, ensuring proper format and that session isn't closed.

methods.name: invalidateAllSessions
methods.description: For testing: invalidates all sessions and clears caches.

methods.name: putSessionForTesting
methods.description: For testing: inserts a session into the session store.
